messages:
Ivy (PM): Quick thread — need a concise experiment spec for routing/tenant isolation options to present to GTM next week. Goal: pick one Q3 pilot + clear acceptance metrics and a rollback gate. Keep notes short.

Priya (Arch): High-level options: 1) 'Latency isolation' lanes (tight p99), 2) 'Cost lanes' (batched, lower unit cost), 3) 'Residency pockets' (region-pin + audit). Each has different data and control needs.

Jo (Eng): Runtime constraints: latency lanes require smaller batch windows and per-tenant KV namespaces; cost lanes favor bigger batch windows and permissive cache sharing. Residency needs KMS + VPC peering.

Chen (SRE): Ops perspective: evacuation & automated drains are critical for any lane. For pilots we should limit blast radius to <= 5% fleet. Canary plan: synthetic traffic + chaos test.

Naomi (Sales): Pipeline note: several enterprise prospects asked specifically for residency + SLA. If we pilot 'latency lanes' we should scope residency discovery in parallel.

Rahul (CS): Customer ask example: legal team requires proof of region pinning + exportable audit events (30d). Also onboarding templates reduce time-to-value.

Ivy (PM): Request: each owner add 2 numeric gates (operational + quality) we can put in the pilot spec. I'll assemble a tiny checklist.

Priya (Arch): Quality gate 1: per-tenant p99 <= 160ms on latency lane (end-to-end). Quality gate 2: cross-tenant tail impact < 7% (99th percentile amplification).

Jo (Eng): Ops gate 1: KV cache hit >= 55% for latency lane (measured over 24h). Ops gate 2: median batch wait < 45ms for low-latency tenants.

Chen (SRE): Ops gate 1: automated drain success >= 95% in canary runs. Ops gate 2: regional failover RTO <= 3 minutes for critical lanes.

Naomi (Sales): Go-to-market gate 1: residency pilot documentation + audit event export ready. Gate 2: 2 paid pilot commitments or 1 paid + one legal sign-off.

Rahul (CS): Customer acceptance gate: onboarding <= 10 business days using templates. Rollout gate: documented rollback steps and customer-visible incident playbook.

Ivy (PM): Draft tiny experiment checklist (will expand into spec):
- Pilot target: 2 tenants on latency lane (one mid-size, one heavy tail).
- Duration: 6 weeks.
- Metrics to collect: per-tenant p50/p95/p99, KV hit, batch window, cost per 1M tokens, failover RTO, drain success rate, audit event delivery latency.
- Success criteria: all numeric gates above met for 10 consecutive days in canary -> escalate to staged rollout.
- Rollback criteria: any two gates breached for 24h OR customer-visible error rate > 0.5% for 1h.

Priya (Arch): Quick config snippet for pilot routing policy (informal):
```
route_policy:
  name: latency-lane-pilot
  affinity: tenant-pin
  cache_scope: per-tenant
  batch_window_ms: 40
  fallback: best-effort-cost-lane
```

Jo (Eng): Implementation notes: we can short-circuit fallback to cost lane for non-critical routes. Need a feature-flagged runtime toggle to flip batching behavior.

Chen (SRE): Canary plan outline: 1) deploy routing policy to a small shard (5 GPUs), 2) synthetic traffic at 50% of expected tenant peak, 3) automated drain + failover dry-run, 4) run chaosnet (target a node) for 1h and verify RTO.

Naomi (Sales): I'll line up 2 potential pilot customers (one fintech, one B2B search). They'll need residency answers for the fintech — can we include a discovery checklist?

Ivy (PM): Discovery checklist for residency asks: KMS integration options, network topology (VPC peering vs private link), audit export format & retention, compliance mapping (SOC2/ISO/GDPR notes). Priya/SRE — can you add a short feasibility note by Tue?

Priya (Arch): Feasibility: KMS and audit events are doable for pilot (work estimate: 2 sprint engineers + 1 infra). VPC peering path adds ops complexity; prefer private link for minimal network changes.

Chen (SRE): Ops estimate: runbooks + canaries + one escalation drill = 2 weeks of SRE effort. Soft-evict automation requires a small API change.

Ivy (PM): Votes for which pathway to run as Q3 pilot? React with :one: latency lanes, :two: cost lanes, :three: residency pockets. Vote by EOD Mon.

Priya (Arch): :one:
Jo (Eng): :one: (can iterate to add residency later)
Chen (SRE): :one:
Naomi (Sales): :three: (but will support latency pilot if residency discovery is prioritized)
Rahul (CS): :one:

Ivy (PM): Consensus trending to latency lanes pilot with explicit residency discovery track. I'll publish a one-pager + tiny spec tomorrow and schedule the kickoff. Thanks. :raised_hands:

deploy-bot: Spec draft 'q3-routing-lanes/latency-pilot' pushed to staging 2026-04-02 08:00 UTC

Ivy (PM): Link will follow. If anyone has a short customer prompt set for quality checks (e.g., edge-case tokenization prompts, long-context rollbacks), paste them here or DM me.
